source_verification: Reviewed both complete scoped diffs and all 17 product Text.fraction call sites plus FractionDirectionTests call site. No remaining Text concatenation or Text-specific typed boundary consumes fraction.

Other callers use View-compatible modifiers, generic trailing View builders or Label title builders. heroNumeral is defined on View. SectionHeader and JourneyCardHeading trailing content are generic View.

The sole concatenation helper lessonCount now uses a firstTextBaseline HStack with fraction and localized lessons. Parent HStack direction remains inherited. Two helper callers accept View-compatible modifiers. Single accessibility element ignores children and keeps the exact prior spoken label expression.
